context: M1 o1. Flatiron north prow, dusk. Mayhew arrives from Fifth Ave.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Look at you. Same corner. You used to stand right there like a fire hydrant.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: You said it was important, Carl. I start at eleven.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Eleven. Behind glass. In a hotel full of old men. That's a career?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: It's a job. You know anybody else hiring guys like me?

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Walk with me. Like old times. Broadway, nice and slow, uptown.
